Name: Craftable Magic Worm Bin
Author: Schneitizel
Description:
Adds a Worm Bin that generates Magic Bait every day

The recipe can be purchased from Willy for 150,000g in the second year


[size=3][b]Recipe :[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Hardwood x25
[*]Iridium Bar x1
[*]Magic Bait x1
[*]Fiber x50
[/list]
Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿!
I recommend the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8111]Walk of Life[/url]﻿ mod for even more efficiency!

[b][size=3]Needed :[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework[/url]
[*]And, of course, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Install :[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Just drag&drop the folder "Magic Worm Bin" in the archive in your "Mods" folder
[/list]
[size=3][b]Uninstall :[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Just delete the folder "Magic Worm Bin", the game will remove the Magic Worm Bin while leaving you your Magic Bait!
[/list]
[size=3][b]Translation :[/b][/size][list]
[*]The mod is available in english (default), russian and french, if you want translate it, you can post the name ("Magic Worm Bin") and the desc ("Produces Magic Bait on a regular basis. The worms are self-sufficient.") in the "post" tab! :)
[/list]
